completion_promises.evidence: scripts/seed_student_model.py defines a `__main__` block running `asyncio.run(main())`. `main()` calls `_parse_args` which uses argparse with a `--config-path` flag (Path type, default None). `load_config(path)` merges YAML overrides onto the Phase-1 Synology defaults. Validated by test_argparse_accepts_config_path_flag and test_load_config_uses_defaults_when_path_omitted / test_load_config_overrides_via_yaml.

completion_promises.criterion_text: [ ] Successful run against Synology FalkorDB: exit code 0, Lilymay's baseline visible via `get_student_state`
completion_promises.evidence: main() returns EXIT_OK (0) on a clean fresh seed. seed_lilymay() calls get_student_state as its post-drain verification gate and logs an event=seeding_completed summary line listing subjects/topic_confidences/succeeded_writes counts. Live FalkorDB run is operator-driven; the orchestration is exercised end-to-end by test_main_returns_zero_on_success which mocks get_client + get_student_state and asserts the helper.drain + close paths fire and main returns 0.

completion_promises.criterion_text: [ ] Re-running the script: exit code 0, log line `event=seeding_skipped, reason=already_seeded`, no duplicate entities created
completion_promises.evidence: seed_lilymay calls get_student_state pre-flight and routes through _is_already_seeded. When the existing baseline is detected (subjects / topic_confidences / year_group present), it logs `event=seeding_skipped, reason=already_seeded` and returns EXIT_OK without scheduling any writes. Validated by test_seed_lilymay_skips_when_already_seeded which asserts both the log record and that helper.calls == [] (zero writes scheduled, hence zero duplicates).

completion_promises.criterion_text: [ ] Store-unreachable: exit code 2, log line `event=seeding_failed, reason=client_unavailable`
completion_promises.evidence: require_client_or_exit(None) raises SystemExit(EXIT_CLIENT_UNAVAILABLE=2) and emits event=seeding_failed, reason=client_unavailable via the module logger. main() invokes require_client_or_exit immediately after get_client. Validated by both test_require_client_or_exit_raises_systemexit_2_on_none (helper-level) and test_main_exits_2_when_get_client_returns_none (end-to-end through main); also covered by the seam test test_graphiti_client_required_at_seed_time.

completion_promises.criterion_text: [ ] Pending-writes-abandoned: exit code 3 with abandoned count if any
completion_promises.evidence: seed_lilymay awaits helper.drain() before the verification gate. If the returned (succeeded, abandoned) tuple has abandoned > 0, it emits event=seeding_pending_writes_abandoned with both counts in extra and returns EXIT_PENDING_WRITES_ABANDONED (3). Validated by test_seed_lilymay_returns_exit_3_when_writes_abandoned which configures a fake helper to report 2 abandoned writes and asserts both the exit code and the structured log.

completion_promises.criterion_text: [ ] At least one topic in each band (struggling / developing / secure) so the planner has shape on day 1
completion_promises.evidence: TOPICS table seeds six topics with initial percentages 25, 35, 55, 60, 75, 80 — confidence_band_for() places these in struggling (25/35), developing (55/60), and secure (75/80) so all three planner-bucket-bands have at least one topic. test_seed_lilymay_covers_all_three_planner_bands collects every TopicConfidenceUpdatedEpisode the script schedules and asserts {struggling, developing, secure} ⊆ {episode.new_band}.

completion_promises.criterion_text: [ ] Initial confidence values committed via the shared async write helper with `flush_id="SEED"` (not raw `add_episode` calls)
completion_promises.evidence: _seed_initial_topic_confidences emits a TopicConfidenceUpdatedEpisode for every topic via helper.schedule_write(group_ids=[student:lilymay], episode=..., flush_id='SEED'). The script contains zero direct calls to add_episode. Validated three ways: (1) test_seed_lilymay_fresh_run_succeeds_and_uses_seed_flush_id asserts every recorded helper.call has flush_id=='SEED'; (2) test_seed_lilymay_topics_match_topic_table asserts every TOPICS row produces a TopicConfidenceUpdatedEpisode; (3) the seam test test_seed_writes_use_seed_flush_id AST-scans the script and asserts every schedule_write keyword arg flush_id is the constant 'SEED'.

completion_promises.criterion_text: [ ] All AOs (AO1–AO6) seeded with AQA-canonical descriptions
completion_promises.evidence: AOS tuple in scripts/seed_student_model.py defines AO1 through AO6 with AQA-canonical descriptions (AO1–AO4 from Lit spec 8702; AO5–AO6 from Lang spec 8700). _seed_assessment_objectives schedules a SeedBaselineEpisode for each AO under group_ids=[FLEET_GROUP_ID]. test_seed_lilymay_seeds_all_six_aos_with_descriptions asserts the seeded AO codes equal {AO1..AO6} exactly and that each AQA description prefix flows through to the rendered episode body.
